source_policy: AGENTS.md; COTS FIRST; source-controlled manufacturer references and deliberate gates

envelope.shutdown_total_battery_target_ua: <100 for TripTracer vehicle system; module budget not yet allocated

requirements.auxiliary_protected_input_voltage: follows_fused_input_after_overvoltage_and_reverse_protection; unregulated, can collapse during cutoff; NOT 5V or fixed 15V
requirements.auxiliary_protected_output_short_circuit: MUST HAVE independently proven current-limiting or suitably DC-rated replaceable branch fuse before any exposed terminal / attached wire; LM74800 is NOT an eFuse
requirements.auxiliary_protected_max_output_current_s: PRELIMINARY_TARGET_TO_DIMENSION_SHARED_SHUNT; not approved to connect before separate branch fuse and connector/wire rating

project_boundaries.standalone_default_on: Draft R319=0R jumper in series with R318=100k from VS_CLAMP to EN; standalone only. D305 blocks backfeed into RUN.
project_boundaries.logic_enable_mode: Draft 3.3/5V active-high RUN_CMD -> R317=4.7k -> D305 reverse blocker -> LM74930 EN with 100k pull-down R316. Raw ACC never directly at RUN. Behavior with VIN=0 and powered RUN needs measurement.
project_boundaries.power_return: Common GND; layout must protect high-current ground and switching return
project_boundaries.output_connector_plan: Schematic J301 VIN_FUSED/RUN_CMD/GND and J302 VIN_PROTECTED/5V_OUT/GND, both 3-wire solder pads. Connector/wire ratings and final PCB footprints not qualified.
project_boundaries.raw_auxiliary_branch: from Q922 drain / U921 OUT and C926 positive = current TripTracer net HV_PROTECTED_AFTER_EFUSE, prior to U101 VIN; physical output separated through own branch protection. Do not connect to raw BAT, SW or 5V.
project_boundaries.raw_auxiliary_branch_status: WIRED_ON_NEW_STANDALONE_SCHEMATIC: U301 C/CS-/R301 -> VIN_PROTECTED_MAIN -> F302 58V replaceable 2A candidate -> J302.pin1; PCB not created; 2A fuse not a 1A current limiter

proposed_external_signals.name: VIN_FUSED
proposed_external_signals.role: fused positive source; not a bare battery cable

proposed_external_signals.name: 5V_OUT
proposed_external_signals.role: regulated rail, overload behavior to be tested

proposed_external_signals.name: VIN_PROTECTED
proposed_external_signals.role: mandatory physical exposed positive terminal via independent branch short-circuit protection; supply is raw post-LM74800 not 5V and not fixed 15V
proposed_external_signals.protection: reverse and OV cut-off share LM74800; output overcurrent, load short, wire fault must have separately proven protection
proposed_external_signals.current_rating_a: TBD after branch fault/I2t, fuse, output connector and total input power allocation

proposed_external_signals.name: RUN_CMD
proposed_external_signals.role: enable request via separate input conditioner; no BAT or VS at logic pin; floating OFF in controlled mode

protection_comparison.design_reason: Programmable combined-load breaker plus short-circuit protection via shared shunt upstream of VIN_PROTECTED branch; LM74800 lacks OCP
open_gates: Shunt and separate auxiliary current fault protection

stop_gates: protection: 9V VS-chargepump dynamic startup and safe EN-off hot leakage
protection: 200V Q921 SOA, Q922 voltage, VS zener and divider pulse ratings
protection: short from fused VIN to GND BEFORE buck, FET shorted, cable fuse coordination
control: source-independent 3.3/5V RUN pin interface and power-off leakage/backfeed
manufacturing: FCH0650-150M pad drawing, exact footprints, paste and 3D
PCB: actual independent native KiCad 10 ERC, PCB parity, routed DRC and review
hardware: 9/12/24/30V 2A thermal, output ripple/EMI, short/fail-off/surge laboratory tests
economics: complete competing 1,10,100pc BOM ex shipping and assembly with live pricing
Aux VIN_PROTECTED: physical independent output connector/pad on standalone PCB tied only to safe post-LM74800 net, NOT raw BAT/SW/5V
Aux VIN_PROTECTED: independently proven branch short-circuit current limiting or appropriately DC-rated replaceable fuse; rated connector/wiring and I2t/fault injection
Aux VIN_PROTECTED: total input/thermal budget must cover max 5V/2A and external raw-side load simultaneously; no unbounded raw output claim
Display: Riverdi constant-current 100mA LED driver from V5_SYS and USB source-current negotiation/derating; no forced 15V constant voltage source

cost_review.reason: Never fabricate mixed tax or stale retailer prices
additional_required_cost_roles: aux branch independent overcurrent limiter or appropriately rated replaceable fuse

display_backlight_design.input_rail: TripTracer V5_SYS after TPS2116 source selector when USB operation of backlight is desired; power budget and USB allowed current mandatory
display_backlight_design.alternative_use_VIN_PROTECTED: NOT_SELECTED; would need 9-30V-capable buck-boost constant-current driver, with own protective load branch

auxiliary_branch_fuse_candidate.rating_conflict_note: Nominal 2A fuse is not a hard current limiter of 1A; shared LM74930 overcurrent protects common path; physical cable and auxiliary PCB copper must be sized for clearing current.
